cause: The initial 32-dimensional, three-layer attention model ran at high GPU utilization but had an impractical per-epoch runtime on the available RTX 4050.
scope: Fold 1 completed with FT AUC 0.76073798 and matched Phase 2 AUC 0.76606925 after 14 selected epochs. Its fold checkpoint and predictions are preserved. Folds 2-5 and the complete OOF/candidate submission were not produced.
resolution: Preserved this run log and reduced the FT model to 16-dimensional tokens, two heads, two encoder layers, batch size 1,024, and an eight-epoch early-stopping patience. Architecture and data protocol remain FT-Transformer and strict inner-only selection.
